title: One Score, Two Decisions: Selective Prediction on the Rare-Disease Tail
abstract: arXiv:2608.14683v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Given a patient's clinical findings, a diagnostic system ranks possible diseases and must decide when to endorse its first prediction or defer it for review. This decision is usually made by thresholding the top score. Selective prediction over ranked outputs begins with two checks. First, the ranker must produce enough correct top-ranked predictions to make the target feasible. Across 2,000 patient records stratified by disease prevalence, eight small open-weight LLMs achieve at most 4.6% Recall@1 on ultra-rare diseases. At 10% coverage, even a perfect confidence ranking of their existing predictions therefore cannot reach 50% selective accuracy. More accurate models pass the same check, showing that the limit is regime-specific. Second, the confidence signal must match the decision being made. For fixed-candidate rankers, the top-two margin cancels components shared across candidates. On phenotype-only Exomiser, it selects 10% of cases

translated_title: 一个评分，两种决策：针对罕见病尾部的选择性预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14683v1 公告类型：新  摘要：给定患者的临床表现，诊断系统会对可能的疾病进行排序，并必须决定何时采纳其第一预测或将其推迟以供审查。这个决定通常通过阈值化最高分数来做出。对排序输出的选择性预测始于两个检查。首先，排序器必须产生足够多的正确顶级预测，以使目标可行。在按疾病患病率分层的2000份患者记录中，八个小型开放权重LLM在超罕见疾病上的Recall@1最多达到4.6%。因此，在10%覆盖率下，即使对其现有预测进行完美的置信度排序，也无法达到50%的选择性准确率。更准确的模型通过了相同的检查，表明该限制是特定于领域的。其次，置信度信号必须与所做的决策相匹配。对于固定候选排序器，前两名之间的差值取消了各候选之间共享的组件。在仅表型Exomiser上，它选择了10%的病例。
tldr: 本文揭示了在罕见病诊断中，选择性预测的可行性受限于排序器在超罕见疾病上的低召回率，且置信度信号需与决策类型匹配，前两名差值作为有效的置信度度量。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that selective prediction feasibility in rare-disease diagnosis is limited by low recall on ultra-rare diseases, and confidence signals must match the decision type, with top-two margin serving as an effective confidence measure.
